author: An Actual Coder

title: Game changer
body:
I’ve been listening to music when studying/working for over 10 years. I’ve been listening to the “correct” music as well, instrumental, right bpm , etc. 

A couple of weeks ago I tried Brain.fm, based on a twitter recommendation. I don’t mean to sound like I’m over selling the app, but for me Brain.fm is a complete game changer. It’s excellent for deep work. My ability to focus has increased so much, and it feels like it’s no extra effort on my behalf. 
The best way I can describe the effect Brain.fm 
has, is that it draws your attention to the screen/book. 
I highly recommend Brain.fm to anyone who wants to increase focus and productivity.

//Anton

title: Warning! Scam! Do not buy!!
body: I bought the monthly subscription after the free trial. The sounds/music was good, it has a nice timer, so even though it’s seriously over priced for what it is, a few sounds with a timer, and costs almost as much as a Netflix or a Spotify subscription. Not great value for money eh? Feels like the creators seriously over values their product, but I thought “hey, if it can help me sleep, it might be worth it” I’m a terribly bad at falling asleep and staying asleep. Anyway, I digress. Immediately after the purchase, I couldn’t log into my account, weird I thought and contacted customer service which answered me fast enough. They were pleasant and accommodating, they didn’t know what the problem was and said they would get back to me, which they did only a day or two later saying they still are looking in to it and that a collogue to the person I chatted to (Sophie) would look into it after the weekend. When I a couple of days passed I had received no response I wrote to them. They didn’t respond. So I wrote again. And again. And again. Now it has been 25! Days since I wrote them and 23 days since I last heard from them!! Apparently they don’t care about the customers as long as they get their money. Watch out!!
